comments.author: SwimmerJazzlike
comments.body: For regular character animations I tried godmodeai ludoai and autosprite, and so far autosprite gives best results. I found grok be the best for generating one off non standard animations and background animations. You have to be strict with it though, it tends to go into anime. When I am satisfied I download a video and extract animation frames with python+ffmpeg

replies.author: Suitable_Decision167
replies.body: So, as far as I understand, you can create a video through Grock with the desired background, and then parse this video into frames and use it in the game as a sprite animation?

replies.author: SwimmerJazzlike
replies.body: Yes. Cleaning up sprite borders is a chore, but other than that it pretty much works

replies.author: Suitable_Decision167
replies.body: Ok thank you very much for your reply. One more question. In your experience, have you been able to create a background with a looping animation using this approach?

replies.author: SwimmerJazzlike
replies.body: Unfortunately no. Looping animation requires more precise control, ability to set last frame, not just first. I was somewhat successful at this when I tried doing character animations locally using wan 2.5, but didn’t tried it with background animations
